summary: Backend retest of the two fixes shipped after iteration_7. Both PASS. (1) GET /api/accounts and POST /api/accounts/sync now filter linked_accounts to provider in {simplefin, missing}, so file-provider rows no longer trigger KeyError('access_url_encrypted'). Verified via a seeded CSV import → subsequent GET /api/accounts=200 (no file row leaks in), POST /api/accounts/sync=200 with {synced,errors}, and NO new Traceback/KeyError/access_url_encrypted in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. (2) file-provider now dedups by (user_id, provider='file', external_id): first CSV upload → inserted=3/duplicates=0; identical re-upload → inserted=0/duplicates>=3; different CSV → inserted>=2/duplicates=0. Prior-iteration regression tests (providers, snaptrade→503, unknown→400, simplefin invalid-token→400, OFX→200, 5MB→413, bad CSV headers→400, support requests POST+GET, /api/accounts/all shape, auth login/me/logout/forgot-password) all still pass. test_providers.py: 16/16, test_regression_fixes.py: 5/5 (new file). Full-suite parallel run (backend_auth_test + test_password_reset + test_simplefin) 34/35 — the single failure `test_forgot_rate_limit_4th_returns_429` is a pre-existing flaky SlowAPI test unrelated to the two fixes (endpoint IS decorated `@limiter.limit('3/minute')` at server.py:313 but the in-memory bucket state after 100+ prior test hits does not deterministically trigger 429 in 6 rapid calls). Password left intact: final curl POST /api/auth/login {alex+test1@jaleter.app / password123} → 200. All file-provider linked_accounts/bank_transactions and TEST_ support_requests created during testing cleaned up (23 linked_accounts, 29 bank_transactions, 3 support_requests deleted).

minor.issue: test_password_reset.py::TestRateLimit::test_forgot_rate_limit_4th_returns_429 sees 6 consecutive 200s instead of a 429. Handler is decorated `@limiter.limit('3/minute')` at server.py:313, so the rule exists. Suspect SlowAPI in-memory bucket window/key-fn behavior when the process has already served many requests. Not a regression from this iteration's two fixes. Recommend main agent revisit only if flaky test is a blocker.

file_provider.py:189-191: dedup filter is now `{'user_id', 'provider', 'external_id'}` (no more per-link account_id in the filter). Verified reupload of identical CSV → 0 inserted / 3 duplicates.

server.py:537 provider_link (simplefin branch): rate limiter concern from iteration_7 is now mitigated — the real Request object is passed through so SlowAPI can attribute the call to the client IP. Verified /api/accounts/link with provider=simplefin returns the same 400 as /api/accounts/simplefin/link.

file_provider.py:163 still mints a NEW `link_id` per upload — that's fine for dedup now (dedup key no longer uses link_id) but does mean a user re-uploading the SAME CSV monthly will still accumulate one `linked_accounts` document per upload, cluttering the Assets list. Consider (future) coalescing file-provider linked_accounts rows by `(user_id, source_file)` on subsequent uploads.

rca_of_issue: Bug #1 root cause was that server.py list_accounts (line 434) and sync_accounts (line 461) queried `db.linked_accounts.find({'user_id': ...})` without a provider filter, so any file-provider doc (which lacks `access_url_encrypted`) caused a KeyError. Fix: added `'$or': [{'provider': {'$exists': False}}, {'provider': 'simplefin'}]` to both cursors, plus SimpleFIN link inserts now write `provider: 'simplefin'` explicitly (server.py:420). Bug #2 root cause was file_provider.py minting a fresh link_id per upload and scoping bank_transactions upserts by (user_id, account_id=link_id, external_id) — since account_id differed per upload the historic rows never matched. Fix: dedup key is now (user_id, provider='file', external_id), so identical rows dedup across arbitrary uploads. Both fixes verified end-to-end via pytest + explicit backend-log inspection.
